title: Social Biases through the Text-to-Image Generation Lens

bias_targets.methodology: Annotating perceived gender in images generated from neutral and expanded text prompts using human crowdsourcing and automated classifiers, and comparing the occupational distributions against US labor statistics and image search baselines.

Classifying perceived race in generated images into specific categories using human evaluators and automated tools (FairFace classifier) to evaluate representational fairness across occupations and personality traits.
Categorizing perceived age groups in generated images through human and automated evaluation to assess demographic representation across various occupations and trait-based prompts.

Calculating the similarity distance of CLIP embeddings between images generated from default, location-neutral situation prompts and country-specific prompts to measure which countries are over- or under-represented.
